public_rationale: The deadline is after October 28, 2026. Existing operations and NVIDIA's infrastructure-compatibility documentation weigh against automatic obsolescence, but neither determines the facilities' commercial usefulness at the deadline. No event meets the early-resolution rule.
limitations: Commercial obsolescence is not precisely defined.
Operator technical claims do not independently establish profitable operation.
The universal facility cohort is not enumerated.

statement.excerpt: By the beginning of 2027, Stargate Abilene will be obsolete, as will any and all data centers filled with Blackwell GPUs, as will any and all data centers being built today.

from_speaker: any and all data centers filled with Blackwell GPUs
any and all data centers being built today
our_interpretation: The plain reading of obsolete is no longer commercially useful for AI workloads, rather than simply no longer containing the newest hardware.
The construction cohort consists of facilities under construction on December 29, 2025.
I interpret the beginning of 2027 as the first quarter, with March 31 as its latest plausible endpoint. A January interpretation would also remain not due at the evaluation date.
Compatibility, actual use, customer demand and operating economics must be assessed together. A newer GPU announcement alone does not establish obsolescence.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence at the deadline establishes commercial obsolescence of Abilene and the entire stated facility cohort, including an inability to serve economically useful AI workloads.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one facility within the stated cohort remains commercially useful for AI workloads at the deadline, supported by actual deployment, customer use and operating evidence.
